Antiplatelet is clopidogrel first-line (NICE TA210) — aspirin is no longer preferred monotherapy for PAD.
Naftidrofuryl oxalate is the ONLY NICE-recommended vasoactive drug (TA223); cilostazol, pentoxifylline and inositol nicotinate
Supervised exercise — not drugs or intervention — is first-line for intermittent claudication.
CLTI is a limb- and life-threatening emergency: 1-year mortality is high — refer urgently and treat CV risk.
